name: @haoking/opencvjs
description: OpenCV 4.14.0 WebAssembly build with an extended Mat operation layer

scripts.bench: ls test/bench/*.bench.js >/dev/null && for f in test/bench/*.bench.js; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.prepack: test -f dist/index.js && test -f dist/index.d.ts && test -f dist/baseline/opencv_js.wasm && test -f dist/simd/opencv_js.wasm || { echo '❌ dist/ 未组装或缺变体：npm 包必须同时含 dist/baseline/ 与 dist/simd/（SIMD 覆盖率只有 93.57%，baseline 是必需的回退）。先跑 npm run assemble <baseline 目录> <simd 目录>'; exit 1; }

author: Haochen Wang
